name: Fluffy American pancakes
title: Pancakes

steps.text: Sift the flour, baking powder, salt and caster sugar into a bowl. Whisk the milk and egg, then whisk in the melted butter.
Pour the milk mixture into the flour and beat with a fork to a smooth batter. Let it stand a few minutes. Optional: oven on low to keep pancakes warm.
Non-stick pan on medium with a knob of butter. A ladle of batter per pancake; flip when the top bubbles, cook until golden and about 1 cm thick. Repeat.
Serve with maple syrup and extra butter. Best fresh from the pan!
